name: Matt Carvin

hero.title: Hi, I'm Matt Carvin.
hero.tagline: Salesforce DevOps engineer. I build CLI plugins and tools that make deployments smaller, faster and easier to review.

links.label: Say hi
links.title: Get in touch: found a bug or have an idea for one of my projects? Open an issue on that repo. Contributions are welcome from forks. Want to collaborate on something new or ask something in general? Open an issue here.

npm._exclude: Platform binaries and -core packages are installed by the main packages, so counting them would count the same install twice.

featured.line: Splits big Salesforce metadata files into small, diff-friendly files and rebuilds them to deploy. Powered by the config-disassembler Rust crate.
Turns Salesforce Apex code coverage JSON into reports for SonarQube, GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps and Bitbucket.
AI-written, plain-English summaries of git diffs for PR descriptions, code review and release notes.
Gets Salesforce orgs ready to deploy Flows as active.

more: Rust crate (with Node bindings via napi-rs) that splits config files into small, VCS-friendly pieces and reassembles them. The engine behind sf-decomposer.
monitor a Salesforce org and expose Prometheus metrics.
export Atlassian Statuspage incidents as Prometheus metrics.
merge multiple Salesforce `package.xml` manifests into one for Salesforce CLI deployments.
convert `package.xml` manifests to and from plain-text lists.
pick the Apex test classes to run in incremental deployments by parsing git commit messages.
GitLab CI/CD template for Salesforce: incremental metadata deployments, sandbox management, and static analysis.

contributions.line: Generates Salesforce incremental deployment content from Git changes.
Assists with Git merge handling for Salesforce metadata.
Identifies the Apex tests to run based on test annotations.
